text:
Evan (CEO): Follow-up from today's all-hands 1: short answers about promos, offer letters, and rebalancing since we ran out of Q&A time.
Rae (People Ops): Are promotion timelines changing because of the reorg? I have a promo packet in review.
Evan (CEO): No change to cadence. Any promo packets already in review will be processed under current criteria; new packets submitted after the roll will reference the updated band wording.
Hector (Head Eng): For teams asked to give up headcount, is there a guarantee to get a backfill within the quarter?
Rae (People Ops): Were committing to prioritize backfills within the quarter. If not possible, well approve contractor support and revisit prioritization.
Nina (Recruiting): Do offer letters change because of new bands? What about candidates with verbal offers?
Rae (People Ops): Verbal offers will be converted using the band active on offer issuance date. People Ops will send a note to hiring managers with affected candidates tomorrow.
Mira (Product): Will managers be able to request headcount swaps between pods? What's the approval path?
Rae (People Ops): Yes. Manager + receiving manager sign-off, cc your People Partner. Budget owner sign-off needed if it crosses cost centers. Use the OrgOps form for traceability.
Samir (Manager): Who runs the leveling calibration for L3->L4? Were seeing inconsistent expectations across pods.
Hector (Head Eng): Ill host a calibration session next Wed 9am PT for Eng leads. Rae will publish the updated leveling doc beforehand.
cal-bot: Event created: "Eng leveling calibration"  Wed 9am PT.
Nina (Recruiting): Any change to referral policy if a hire is a rebalanced role (not net-new)?
Rae (People Ops): Referral bonus applies only to net-new headcount. Internal moves are excluded.
Evan (CEO): If anyone has edge cases (pending offers, promotions, or cross-budget swaps), ping Rae + me and well triage. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
